name: logo-cloud

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the scrolling row centred with six logos fully readable above the still grid.

tagline: A sliding band of brand logos sits above a still logo grid.
summary: A social-proof block: one row of company logos drifts sideways behind soft edge fades, with a second static row of the same marks underneath.
appearance: Two stacked rows of small white brand logos on near-black. The upper row is a continuous moving strip that fades at both ends under the label Trusted by developers worldwide; the lower grid is static under BUILT WITH.
behaviour: The top row scrolls steadily from right to left on a loop, repeating the same logos. The bottom grid never moves.
demo_content: Vercel, React, Next.js, Tailwind, GitHub, Stripe, Figma and Supabase logos.
use_when: A landing page wants to show partner or customer brands without spending much space.
avoid_when: Logos are forced to solid white by a brightness filter, so multicolour brand marks lose their identity.
customise: logos (name and image path), title and className are props on each of the three variants; the scroll speed and fade mask are fixed.
weight_why: A duplicated row of images moved by one CSS keyframe; no script.

a11y.note: Images carry alt names, but the endless marquee ignores reduced-motion and cannot be paused.

issues: The forced monochrome filter flattens every brand's colours.
polish_why: Tidy and understated, but it is a standard logo wall with flattened brand marks.
title: Logo Cloud
